command:
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/admin/overlay/Avelino
tar -xf - -C /tmp/admin
for f in /avelino/qml/Avelino/*; do
  name=${f##*/}
  if [ "$name" != qmldir ]; then ln -s "$f" "/tmp/admin/overlay/Avelino/$name"; fi
done
sed '/^prefer /d' /avelino/qml/Avelino/qmldir > /tmp/admin/overlay/Avelino/qmldir
cp /tmp/admin/src/Avelino/*.qml /tmp/admin/overlay/Avelino/
cat >> /tmp/admin/overlay/Avelino/qmldir <<'QMLDIR'
BleeckerAdminShell 0.1 BleeckerAdminShell.qml
internal DesktopNavigationToolbar DesktopNavigationToolbar.qml
internal DesktopSidebarGlyph DesktopSidebarGlyph.qml
QMLDIR
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/admin/runtime
mkdir -m 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1
Xvfb -displayfd 3 -screen 0 2560x1920x24 -nolisten tcp -noreset 3>"$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/display" >/tmp/admin/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
xpid=$!
trap 'kill "$xpid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do if [[ -s "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/display" ]]; then break; fi; kill -0 "$xpid"; sleep 0.05; done
export DISPLAY=:"$(cat "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/display")"
xdotool mousemove --sync 2559 1919
xdpyinfo | head -n 12
/opt/qt/bin/qmltestrunner -import /tmp/admin/overlay -input /tmp/admin/tests/components -o -,txt
contextAdapter: Same witness JSON supplied as a QML property in place of the compiled test main context
